changes.summary: New optional setting (default 1) to fetch list API pages in parallel during large reads; set GENESYSCLOUD_MAX_CONCURRENT_PAGES and increase token_pool_size alongside higher values.
Maximum allowed value increased from 20 to 50; description documents OAuth startup cost, rate-limit risk, and alignment with max_concurrent_pages.
